objections.claim_attacked: chosen_intervention: OpenSTA removes min/max_clock_tree_path delays from macro-model setup/hold times and clock-to-output delays under ideal clocks
objections.objection: The only commit evidence quoted in the record is titled around removing clock-tree delay from clk->output in an ideal-clock context; the stated setup/hold-time correction is broader than that title and needs the thread to show setup/hold checks consume the same adjusted macro delays, not merely that clk-q delay was stripped.

objections.claim_attacked: observation/prior_state: setup line '156.17 156.17 ^ ces_0_4/io_lsbOuts_3' with ca. 70ps macro insertion delay alongside HOLD_SLACK_MARGIN=-300
objections.objection: The numeric package is internally under-specified: 156.17 has no units or field legend, the duplicated value is unexplained, and -300 is not tied to ps/ns, so the record cannot show whether 70ps is large relative to the setup or hold margins.

objections.claim_attacked: candidates_considered: parallaxsw's two-Liberty-model option was rejected as impractical for third-party IP while precisionmoon noted third-party .lib can be edited
objections.objection: This is a soft tension rather than a contradiction: editable third-party .lib makes the option technically possible, but the record gives no cost/validation burden to explain why editability does not make it practical.

mechanism_check: HOLDS — If propagated-clock macro Liberty models bake clock-network delay into requirements/delays that are invalid when the top clock is ideal, subtracting/removing those baked delays in ideal-clock contexts plausibly removes the false violations.
evidence_check: MEAS — The post-state is a real reporter re-run of mock-array reporting no false timing violations, but it is narrow, self-reported, lacks before/after QoR-runtime numbers, and is not a megaboom retest.
attribution_check: SUPPORTS — The direct_quote has a named participant, date, locator, and states the core propagated-clock-model/ideal-clock-context mechanism; it supports the diagnosis but not by itself the specific commit a82361ce implementation.
missing_from_story: Exact units and field meaning for the 156.17 156.17 timing line and for HOLD_SLACK_MARGIN=-300
The actual Liberty min/max_clock_tree_path values present in the macro models and whether all macros or only some carried them
A megaboom rerun after the STA submodule update, plus before/after runtime, violation-count, WNS/TNS, and residual-error deltas
Which check arcs were changed: setup, hold, clock-to-output, or all macro timing arcs, and under what ideal-clock detection condition
most_defensible_part: parallaxsw's causal diagnosis that propagated-clock-generated timing models can make setup/hold requirements wrong when reused in an ideal-clock context.
